Uniform support-alias bound splits singleton boxes and >=2 boxes. The integer-phase cluster interval follows from small increments of log2(n alpha). An executable independent small-case check covers exact coefficients and modal closure.

originality.rationale: The new joint statement is an exact probability of generating an entire finite S5 powerset algebra from random predicates on a Bell-uniform equivalence frame, with sharp n log n scaling and a quantized observation-phase interval. Verified 2025--26 S5 sources study categorical semantics/definability, Horn 1978 deterministically describes free S5 algebras, while Stam/Chern supply urn and block-count facts. The deterministic and probabilistic components do not alone state the new coupled probability classification. Actual semantic published-finding and literature searches found related but different claims. Horn full text and possible alternative random-generator formulations remain genuine priority risks. Zantedeschi 2026 addresses modal exchangeability for valuations on frames; its fixed-frame de Finetti representation does not determine Bell-uniform random modal generation.
residual_risks: Horn 1978 full text remained inaccessible in this execution: deterministic generator/support characterizations may be stronger than indexed snippets reveal.
A result framed as random colors of uniform set partitions, rather than modal algebras, could imply the exact probability/threshold; negative web/published-finding searches are not uniqueness proofs.
The asymptotics use cited concentration of the Stam auxiliary M, not a newly derived local saddle-point estimate.
Independent scientific review has not been performed.

It yields complete finite enumerations, exact feasibility, critical asymptotics and a logarithmic-rounding cluster interval. It goes beyond a bare computation of an unmotivated invariant.
